name: Hilton Moorea Lagoon Resort
insider_take: Wake up to views of Tahiti's iconic peaks rising from crystal-clear lagoon waters – this overwater paradise puts you literally above one of the world's most pristine coral gardens.
whats_special: The resort sits on a sacred motu (coral islet) that ancient Polynesians considered a spiritual gateway. Your overwater bungalow is built above a natural aquarium where blacktip reef sharks, stingrays, and tropical fish glide beneath your glass floor panels. The lagoon here maintains a constant 79°F year-round thanks to underground thermal springs.
pro_tip: Book bungalows 50-56 for the most dramatic Tahiti mountain views, and visit the lagoon at sunset when the water turns electric blue – a phenomenon locals call "l'heure bleue."
dont_miss: Snorkeling the Tiki Village reef just 200 yards from your bungalow, where Napoleon wrasse and eagle rays frequent the coral drop-off. The resort's position offers front-row seats to Moorea's famous "heart-shaped" mountain silhouette, best photographed from the overwater restaurant at golden hour.
pros: Overwater bungalows with direct lagoon access
Stunning panoramic views of Tahiti across the lagoon
Multiple dining options including overwater restaurant
Full-service spa and extensive water sports activities
cons: Remote island location requiring inter-island transportation
Premium pricing typical of luxury overwater resorts
